thread.title: Apple target cut at Needham amid emerging-market weakness - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple target cut at Needham amid emerging-market weakness - MarketWatch
text: Needham analyst Laura Martin lowered her price target on Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.36% shares to $200 from $260 on Thursday, though she kept a buy rating on shares. Martin worries about increased China risk due to trade-war tensions and a dispute with Qualcomm Inc. QCOM, +0.23% and weak iPhone demand in India. She's also concerned about a potential global downturn. "Any offshore economic slowdown would hurt Apple which targets only the wealthiest consumers globally," she said. Nonetheless, Martin remained largely upbeat about Apple's long-term prospects, arguing that the company's balance sheet "can withstand virtually anything" and that enhancements to its sticky ecosystem continue to increase the "lifetime value" of those who own Apple products. The stock has fallen 27% over the past three months, as the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.86% has fallen 12.5%.
